name: crip-governance
description: CRIP domain agent: security, reliability, network and policy posture of a subscription.
summary: Security score, Advisor reliability and security advice, network exposure and policy compliance.

delegation_tool.name: ask_governance
delegation_tool.description: Ask the Governance agent about the POSTURE of a subscription, not its cost: security (Defender for Cloud secure score, unhealthy security recommendations), reliability / operational excellence / performance advice from Azure Advisor, NETWORK exposure (SSH/RDP open to the internet, subnets without NSGs, storage reachable from all networks, broken VNet peerings, public IPs) and Azure POLICY compliance. Answers come from Azure Advisor, Defender for Cloud, Azure Resource Graph and Azure Policy.

examples: Do I have any network security issues?
What is my secure score and what should I fix first?
Which policies are my resources not compliant with?

tools.name: governance_advisor_recommendations
tools.description: Azure Advisor recommendations other than cost (security, reliability, operational excellence, performance), ordered by impact.

category.description: Advisor category. Defaults to all non-cost categories.

top_n.description: How many recommendations to itemise. Defaults to 15.

tools.name: governance_security_posture
tools.description: Defender for Cloud secure score and the unhealthy security recommendations affecting the most resources.

tools.name: governance_network_posture
tools.description: Network configuration checks: SSH/RDP open to the internet, subnets without an NSG, storage accounts reachable from all networks, VNet peerings not connected, public IP addresses.

tools.name: governance_policy_compliance
tools.description: Azure Policy compliance: number of non-compliant resources and the assignments they violate.
